svg.title: Snake: the board is a PRG32 tile playfield
svg.text: The board is a playfield of tiles: the screen is also the game's memory
visible window: 40 x 25 tiles of 8 x 8 pixels = 320 x 200
Five tiles, each an 8 x 8 picture with two colours

g.text: put tile 3 on layer 0 at column x row y
The firmware paints all 1000 visible tiles.
Only changed cells are written each move.

svg.text: Collision detection becomes a memory lookup: the tile map is both the picture and the data structure.
